Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Vast
Hirelings: 4
Order: Empower

A Bastion can have more than one Training Area: an open courtyard, a gymnasium, a music or dance hall, or a clever gauntlet of traps and hazards, with targets, padded mats, and other equipment. One hireling is an expert trainer; the others are training partners. Choose a trainer from the Expert Trainers table when you add the facility; you can replace them with another on each Bastion turn.

Empower: Training. The hirelings run training exercises for 7 days. Any character who trains here for at least 8 hours on each of those days gains the benefit of the trainer present, as shown in the table, for 7 days.

TrainerEmpower Benefit
Battle ExpertWhen you take damage from an attack made with an Unarmed Strike or a weapon, you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d4.
Skills ExpertYou gain proficiency in Acrobatics, Athletics, Performance, Sleight of Hand, or Stealth (your choice).
Tools ExpertYou gain proficiency with one tool of your choice.
Unarmed Combat ExpertWhen you hit with your Unarmed Strike and deal damage, it deals an extra 1d4 Bludgeoning damage.
Weapon ExpertChoose a kind of Simple or Martial weapon. If you aren't proficient with it, you gain proficiency; if you are, you can use its mastery property.
